text:
maria: quick design check — saved-view ownership for console analytics. should per-route saved queries be route-scoped by default or global at org level? prototyping the editor.
ajay: i vote route-scoped default. route owners get edit rights, but we should support pinning a view to org/team.
sophie: route default makes sense. API needs a clear param: GET /api/v1/console/views?scope=route|org|team and returned object should include owner/team id.
ben: if we go route-scoped, how do we expose model-specific columns? i.e. some routes use llama-2-70b vs a smaller quantized variant — columns differ.
maria: idea: view editor has a "model columns" toggle. when on, it shows model-specific metrics: p50, p95, avg cost/token, default sampling rate.
kevin: callout: telemetry sample-rate must be surfaced on the view. don't show raw counts without a "sampled X%" badge — folks will misinterpret.
console-bot: Deploy scheduled: saved-views-share rollback patch to staging at 2024-11-05T09:30Z. @maria
ajay: tiny UX thought: compact mode in the route list should let you apply a saved view with one click (dropdown + eye icon). keep it fast.
sophie: permission edge: if a saved view references a private model (customer-only), it shouldn't be shown org-wide. show placeholder + CTA to request access.
maria: implementation notes (rough): savedView = {"filters": ["route_id:abc"], "columns": ["p95","cost_per_token"], "scope": "route", "owner": "team-platform", "modelColumnsEnabled": true}
ben: example addition to API response:
```
{
  "id": "v_123",
  "scope": "route",
  "owner": "team-platform",
  "isPinned": false,
  "samplingInfo": "sampled:10%",
  "columns": ["p50","p95","error_rate"]
}
```
kevin: migration concern: existing saved queries (no scope) should default to route-scope but we must record if user had global intent. audit log that migration.
ajay: API question: should we support transfer of ownership? PATCH /api/v1/console/views/:id/transfer {owner: "team-x"} — useful for org admins.
sophie: also need e2e: verify visibility matrix (route owner, team member, org admin) + telemetry badges render correctly under different sample rates.
maria: for console mocks i'll add a tiny badge UI: "sampled 10%" and a tooltip: "metrics are estimated; enable full telemetry to see raw counts".
ben: preview UX: add a "preview N rows" async job so heavy queries don't block UI. show spinner + ETA (approx).
kevin: also confirm behavior on Dedicated/Private deployments: default sharing policy might differ (org-only on Private). add config flag.
maria: ok updating spec + figma. i'll open a PR for the API contract and add to the backlog for migration tasks. tagging @ajay @sophie for review. :thumbsup:
ajay: lgtm, will add API tests.
sophie: will add UI tests. ping me when mock is up.
ben: leaving a couple of notes in the doc about column id naming to avoid collisions with future metrics.
kevin: thanks — this clarifies a lot. :smile:
__comment: single-thread slack export style; messages are short and in chronological order
